allowed_use: freeze geometry thresholds for an independent-seed holdout and, only after that holdout passes, the bound full docking matrix
forbidden_use: threshold fitting from holdout/mutant results or biological ranking from these WT calibration poses

definitions.calibration_positive_pose: inside the shared docking box, has a standard ProLIF contact, and belongs to the unique modal protein-closer atom-count group for the receptor/ligand across both WT seeds
definitions.height_window: receptor-level minimum/maximum calibration-positive absolute membrane height, expanded by the frozen numeric margin
definitions.pose_population_limit: minimum passing count across the two WT seeds minus the frozen absolute passing-mode margin
definitions.protein_limit: ceiling of the frozen fraction times the ligand-specific modal protein-closer atom count
definitions.radial_limit: receptor-level maximum calibration-positive radial distance, expanded by the frozen numeric margin; evaluated strictly less than
